The dose is judged on the signal the generator will see (gainSignalMean with\n * the reference the generator will get), so the check and the generator cannot disagree. Returns 0 and the max/min ratio, or 12 with the reason on stderr.\n */\nint checkSingleDose(const std::vector<InputFrame>& brights, const std::vector<uint16_t>& ref, const std::string& refLabel, double* ratio) {\n    const InputFrame* lo = nullptr;\n    const InputFrame* hi = nullptr;\n    double loSig = 0.0, hiSig = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& b : brights) {\n        const double sig = gainSignalMean(b.px, ref);\n        if (sig <= 0.0) {\n            std::fprintf(stderr, \"%s: no signal is left after subtracting the gain dark reference (%s): mean of max(0, frame - reference) is %.3f; not a bright frame for this reference\\n\",\n                         b.path.c_str(), refLabel.c_str(), sig);\n            return 12;\n        }\n        if (!lo || sig < loSig) { lo = &b; loSig = sig; }\n        if (!hi || sig > hiSig) { hi = &b; hiSig = sig; }\n    }\n    *ratio = hiSig / loSig;\n    if (*ratio > kGainDoseRatioLimit) {\n        std::fprintf(stderr,\n                     \"bright frames for the gain map span more than one dose: gain signal (mean of max(0, frame - gain dark reference %s)) from %.1f (%s) to %.1f (%s), ratio %.3f, limit %.2f. The gain \"\n                     \"generator averages its frames and assumes one dose; give frames of one dose with --bright (frames of several doses may go to the defect map with --bpm-bright)\\n\",\n                     refLabel.c_str(), loSig, lo->path.c_str(), hiSig, hi->path.c_str(), *ratio, kGainDoseRatioLimit);\n        return 12;\n    }\n    return 0;\n}\n\n// QA-A-250c: the same file twice in one role. A path duplicate is the same normalized path or the same file (fs::equivalent: links, case, ..), a content\n// duplicate the same sha-256. The first would be counted twice toward the frame minimum and averaged twice; a duplicate is refused (exit 13), not skipped.\nint rejectPathDuplicates(const std::vector<std::string>& paths, const char* role) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < paths.size(); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < paths.size(); ++j) {\n            std::error_code ec;\n            const bool same = fs::path(paths[i]).lexically_normal() == fs::path(paths[j]).lexically_normal() || fs::equivalent(paths[i], paths[j], ec);\n            if (same) {\n                std::fprintf(stderr, \"duplicate %s frame: '%s' and '%s' are the same file; a frame is given once per role\\n\", role, paths[i].c_str(), paths[j].c_str());\n                return 13;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint rejectContentDuplicates(const std::vector<const InputFrame*>& frames, const char* role) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < frames.size(); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < frames.size(); ++j) {\n            if (frames[i]->sha == frames[j]->sha) {\n                std::fprintf(stderr, \"duplicate %s frame: '%s' and '%s' have the same content (sha-256 %s); a frame is given once per role\\n\", role, frames[i]->path.c_str(),\n                             frames[j]->path.c_str(), frames[i]->sha.c_str());\n                return 13;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return 0;\n}\n\n// Test seam: XPE_FIXTURE_GEN_FAIL=<stage> forces that stage to fail (gain, bpm, manifest, commit) so the rollback paths can be exercised.\nbool forcedFailure(const char* stage) {\n#ifdef _WIN32\n    char* v = nullptr;\n    size_t len = 0;\n    const bool hit = _dupenv_s(&v, &len, \"XPE_FIXTURE_GEN_FAIL\") == 0 && v != nullptr && std::strcmp(v, stage) == 0;\n    std::free(v);\n    return hit;\n#else\n    const char* v = std::getenv(\"XPE_FIXTURE_GEN_FAIL\");\n    return v != nullptr && std::strcmp(v, stage) == 0;\n#endif\n}\n\n// The work directory is a sibling of --out with a name of this run alone (<out>.building-<pid>-<ms>), so a leftover of a killed run or a run on the same\n// --out at the same time never shares it. It is created empty and is never cleaned up on behalf of another run. It is removed in every case (after a\n// successful publish it no longer exists), together with the parent directories this run had to create.\nstruct WorkDir {\n    fs::path path, firstExisting;\n    bool     created{false};\n    explicit WorkDir(const fs::path& out) {\n        fs::path abs = fs::absolute(out).lexically_normal();\n        if (abs.filename().empty()) abs = abs.parent_path();\n        const long long ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();\n        path = abs.parent_path() / (abs.filename().string() + \".building-\" + std::to_string(XPE_GETPID()) + \"-\" + std::to_string(ms));\n        firstExisting = abs;\n        std::error_code ec;\n        while (!firstExisting.empty() && !fs::exists(firstExisting, ec) && firstExisting != firstExisting.parent_path()) firstExisting = firstExisting.parent_path();\n        fs::create_directories(path.parent_path(), ec);\n        created = fs::create_directory(path, ec);   // false when the name is taken: never adopt a directory that is not ours\n    }\n    bool ok() const { return created; }\n    ~WorkDir() {\n        std::error_code ec;\n        if (created) fs::remove_all(path, ec);\n        for (fs::path d = path.parent_path(); !d.empty() && d != firstExisting && d != d.parent_path(); d = d.parent_path()) fs::remove(d, ec);   // only if empty\n    }\n};\n\n// QA-A-250d: publishes the finished set with one directory rename onto --out. There is no overwrite and nothing is moved aside: --out does not exist, or is\n// an empty directory (removed here, put back if the rename fails). A failed rename is a failure (exit 8), never reported as success.\nint publishSet(const fs::path& work, const fs::path& out) {\n    std::error_code ec;\n    const bool wasEmptyDir = fs::is_directory(out, ec);\n    if (wasEmptyDir) {\n        fs::remove(out, ec);   // removes an empty directory only\n        if (ec) {\n            std::fprintf(stderr, \"cannot publish into %s: %s\\n\", out.string().c_str(), ec.message().c_str());\n            return 8;\n        }\n    }\n    if (forcedFailure(\"commit\")) ec = std::make_error_code(std::errc::io_error);\n    else fs::rename(work, out, ec);\n    if (ec) {\n        if (wasEmptyDir) fs::create_directory(out, ec);\n        std::fprintf(stderr, \"publishing the finished set to %s failed; nothing was published\\n\", out.string().c_str());\n        return 8;\n    }\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint runFramesMode(const Options& opt) {\n    const fs::path out(opt.outDir);\n    const size_t pixelCount = static_cast<size_t>(opt.width) * opt.height;\n\n    std::vector<std::string> darkPaths = opt.darkFiles, brightPaths = opt.brightFiles;\n    if (!opt.darkList.empty() && !readList(opt.darkList, &darkPaths)) return 9;\n    if (!opt.brightList.empty() && !readList(opt.brightList, &brightPaths)) return 9;\n    std::vector<std::string> bpmPaths = opt.bpmBrightFiles;\n    if (!opt.bpmBrightList.empty() && !readList(opt.bpmBrightList, &bpmPaths)) return 9;\n    const bool separateBpm = !bpmPaths.empty();\n\n    {\n        std::error_code ec;\n        if (fs::exists(out, ec)) {\n            if (!fs::is_directory(out, ec)) {\n                std::fprintf(stderr, \"cannot create output directory: %s exists and is not a directory\\n\", opt.outDir.c_str());\n                return 3;\n            }\n            if (!fs::is_empty(out, ec)) {\n                std::fprintf(stderr, \"output directory %s is not empty: nothing was written. RenderedVoiAutomatic => _render?.Voi.Automatic;\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// GUI-C-233g: THE place a render becomes the one on screen, and the only place it stops being (with <see cref=\"InvalidateRender\"/>, which calls it with null). THIS IS A PROXY,\n    // not the moment the picture is on the screen: Rendering is raised BEFORE the frame is rendered. The independent observation of the screen is made from outside, by the E2E (W15, GUI-C-236c).\n    // The first display pipeline that completes after an open consumes the start.\n    private long _openStartedAt;\n    private long _openReadEndedAt;\n    private int _openGeneration;\n    private int _frameTimingSequence;\n    private string _frameTimingText = string.Empty;\n    private CancellationTokenSource _frameTimingLifetime = new();\n\n    /// <summary>How a wait for composition ticks ended.</summary>\n    internal enum CompositionWait\n    {\n        Ticked,\n        TimedOut,\n        Cancelled,\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>How many waits for composition ticks hold a subscription to <c>CompositionTarget.Rendering</c> right now. Must be 0 when nothing is waiting: the subscription is released on every way out (ticked, timed out, cancelled).</summary>\n    internal static int ActiveCompositionSubscriptions;\n\n    /// <summary>Replaces the wait for composition ticks (the SelfCheck runner has no window, so no tick ever comes). Null: the real one.</summary>\n    internal Func<int, TimeSpan, CancellationToken, Task<CompositionWait>>? CompositionTicksOverride { get; set; }\n\n    /// <summary>The longest the wait for the second tick is allowed to take (a minimised window raises none).</summary>\n    internal TimeSpan FrameTimingLimit { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);\n\n    /// <summary>One line, written when the second composition tick after an open's processed picture has passed: <c>open-to-2nd-tick (proxy) #n: T ms = read a + prepare b + chain-and-display c [stage times] + ui d + render e</c>. Empty until the first one.</summary>\n    public string FrameTimingText\n    {\n        get => _frameTimingText;\n        private set => SetProperty(ref _frameTimingText, value);\n    }\n\n    private static double Milliseconds(long from, long to) => (to - from) * 1000.0 / System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.Frequency;\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// GUI-C-236c: waits for <paramref name=\"ticks\"/> composition ticks, for at most <paramref name=\"limit\"/>, or until <paramref name=\"cancel\"/>. The subscription to <c>CompositionTarget.Rendering</c> is taken\n    /// and released HERE and nowhere else, and it is released in a <c>finally</c>: whichever way the wait ends, no handler is left behind (a static event keeps every handler - and the closure it holds - alive).\n    /// WPF can raise <c>Rendering</c> more than once for one frame; a frame is told by its <c>RenderingTime</c>, so one frame counts once.\n    /// </summary>\n    internal static async Task<CompositionWait> WaitForCompositionTicksAsync(int ticks, TimeSpan limit, CancellationToken cancel)\n    {\n        var done = new TaskCompletionSource<CompositionWait>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);\n        var seen = 0;\n        TimeSpan? lastFrame = null;\n        EventHandler handler = (_, e) =>\n        {\n            var frame = (e as System.Windows.Media.RenderingEventArgs)?.RenderingTime;\n            if (frame is not null && frame == lastFrame)\n            {\n                return;\n            }\n\n            lastFrame = frame;\n            if (++seen >= ticks)\n            {\n                done.TrySetResult(CompositionWait.Ticked);\n            }\n        };\n\n        using var timeout = new CancellationTokenSource(limit);\n        using var onTimeout = timeout.Token.Register(() => done.TrySetResult(CompositionWait.TimedOut));\n        using var onCancel = cancel.Register(() => done.TrySetResult(CompositionWait.Cancelled));\n        try\n        {\n            Interlocked.Increment(ref ActiveCompositionSubscriptions);\n            System.Windows.Media.CompositionTarget.Rendering += handler;\n            return await done.Task;\n        }\n        finally\n        {\n            System.Windows.Media.CompositionTarget.Rendering -= handler;\n            Interlocked.Decrement(ref ActiveCompositionSubscriptions);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Called when the backend is going away (the window is closing): a wait still running ends as cancelled and writes nothing.</summary>\n    private void CancelFrameTiming()\n    {\n        var old = Interlocked.Exchange(ref _frameTimingLifetime, new CancellationTokenSource());\n        old.Cancel();\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Waits for the second composition tick after <paramref name=\"shown\"/> was handed to the viewport and writes the line - unless, when the wait ends, it no longer describes what is on screen: a newer\n    /// open began (<paramref name=\"generation\"/> is no longer the current one) or another picture replaced <paramref name=\"shown\"/>. A wait that ran out its limit is written AND marked as timed out\n    /// (in the line and in the log); a wait cancelled because the window is closing writes nothing.\n    /// </summary>\n    private async Task PublishFrameTimingAsync(int generation, System.Windows.Media.ImageSource shown, long openStartedAt, long readEndedAt, long applyStartedAt, long workEndedAt, long shownAt, string stageTimes)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            if (CompositionTicksOverride is null && System.Windows.Application.Current is null)\n            {\n                return;\n            }\n\n            var wait = await (CompositionTicksOverride ?? WaitForCompositionTicksAsync)(2, FrameTimingLimit, _frameTimingLifetime.Token);\n            var renderedAt = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();\n            if (wait == CompositionWait.Cancelled)\n            {\n                Log($\"Frame timing of open #{generation} not written: the window is closing.\");\n                return;\n            }\n\n            if (generation != _openGeneration || !ReferenceEquals(ProcessedImage, shown))\n            {\n                Log($\"Frame timing of open #{generation} dropped: {(generation != _openGeneration ? $\"open #{_openGeneration} began meanwhile\" : \"another picture replaced it\")}.\");\n                return;\n            }\n\n            var text = $\"open-to-2nd-tick (proxy) #{++_frameTimingSequence}: {Milliseconds(openStartedAt, renderedAt):0} ms = read {Milliseconds(openStartedAt, readEndedAt):0} + prepare {Milliseconds(readEndedAt, applyStartedAt):0}\"\n                       + $\" + chain-and-display {Milliseconds(applyStartedAt, workEndedAt):0} [{stageTimes.Replace(\"times: \", string.Empty)}] + ui {Milliseconds(workEndedAt, shownAt):0} + render {Milliseconds(shownAt, renderedAt):0}\"\n                       + (wait == CompositionWait.TimedOut ? $\" (TIMED OUT: no second composition tick within {FrameTimingLimit.TotalSeconds:0.#} s; the render figure is a lower bound)\" : string.Empty);\n            FrameTimingText = text;\n            Log(text);\n        }\n        catch (Exception ex)\n        {\n            Log($\"Frame timing not written: {ex.Message}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// GUI-C-233h: adds what becomes known AFTER the commit (the lane pictures, the timings) to the record it belongs to - and only if that render is still the one on screen. Each is caught on its own so one missing library does not hide the state\n    /// of the others, and the outcome of every probe is written to the log rather than summarised away.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void RunPInvokeSmokeTest()\n    {\n        var outcomes = new List<string>();\n        var failed = 0;\n\n        // Probe 1: allocate and release a buffer through xpe_common. Chosen because it both crosses the\n        // ABI and returns something checkable \u2014 a code AND a non-null pointer.\n        try\n        {\n            var code = XpeCommonNative.xpe_alloc_image(16, 16, XpePixelFormatNative.UInt16, out var buffer);\n            if (code != 0)\n            {\n                failed++;\n                outcomes.Add($\"xpe_alloc_image -> code {code} (expected 0)\");\n            }\n            else if (buffer.Data == IntPtr.Zero)\n            {\n                failed++;\n                outcomes.Add(\"xpe_alloc_image -> code 0 but a null data pointer\");\n                XpeCommonNative.xpe_free_image(ref buffer);\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                var freeCode = XpeCommonNative.xpe_free_image(ref buffer);\n                if (freeCode != 0)\n                {\n                    failed++;\n                    outcomes.Add($\"xpe_free_image -> code {freeCode} (expected 0)\");\n                }\n                else\n                {\n                    outcomes.Add(\"xpe_alloc_image/xpe_free_image -> ok\");\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        catch (Exception ex)\n        {\n            failed++;\n            outcomes.Add($\"xpe_alloc_image threw {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}\");\n        }\n\n        // Probe 2: the display library answers with a version string, and it is not the mock's.\n        try\n        {\n            var version = XpeDisplayNative.GetVersion();\n            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(version) || version == \"unknown\")\n            {\n                failed++;\n                outcomes.Add($\"xpe_display_version -> '{version}'\");\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                outcomes.Add($\"xpe_display_version -> '{version}'\");\n            }\n        }\n        catch (Exception ex)\n        {\n            failed++;\n            outcomes.Add($\"xpe_display_version threw {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}\");\n        }\n\n        // Probe 3: the alert queue answers. A negative count would mean the call crossed but the\n        // contract did not hold, which is a different failure from the library being absent.\n        try\n        {\n            var count = XpeCommonNative.xpe_get_pending_alert_count();\n            if (count < 0)\n            {\n                failed++;\n                outcomes.Add($\"xpe_get_pending_alert_count -> {count} (expected >= 0)\");\n            }\n            else\n            {\n                outcomes.Add($\"xpe_get_pending_alert_count -> {count}\");\n            }\n        }\n        catch (Exception ex)\n        {\n            failed++;\n            outcomes.Add($\"xpe_get_pending_alert_count threw {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}\");\n        }\n\n        var total = outcomes.Count;\n        PInvokeSmokeTestPassed = failed == 0;\n        PInvokeSmokeTestDetail = string.Join(\"; \", outcomes);\n        StatusText = failed == 0\n            ? $\"P/Invoke smoke: {total} of {total} probes answered.\"\n            : $\"P/Invoke smoke FAILED: {failed} of {total} probes did not answer.\";\n\n        Log($\"P/Invoke smoke ({(failed == 0 ? \"PASS\" : \"FAIL\")}): {string.Join(\"; \", outcomes)}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Whether the last <see cref=\"RunPInvokeSmokeTestCommand\"/> run passed; null before it has run.\n    /// Exposed so the automation report and the E2E scenarios read the SAME value the user sees rather\n    /// than re-deriving it.\n    /// </summary>\n    public bool? The status line\n    /// says \"did not run\" for the first and \"FAILED (exit N)\" for the second (GUI-C-177).</para>\n    /// </summary>\n    private async Task<bool?> ExecuteRunnerAsync(\n        string label, string exePath, IReadOnlyList<string>? arguments, string? workingDirectory,\n        Func<string, string?>? summarize)\n    {\n        StatusText = $\"Running {label}\u2026\";\n        Log($\"{label} started: '{exePath}'.\");\n\n        try\n        {\n            var outcome = await Task.Run(() => RunnerProcess.Run(exePath, arguments, workingDirectory, summarize));\n\n            // The wording, and with it the difference between \"could not be started\" and \"ran and failed\", is\n            // RunnerProcess.Describe's: nothing here words an outcome. A start that failed has a null verdict,\n            // \"did not run\", which is not a failure and is not recorded as one (GUI-C-177).\n            StatusText = RunnerProcess.Describe(label, exePath, outcome, quotesSummary: summarize is not null);\n            Log(outcome.Started\n                ? $\"{label} finished: exit={outcome.ExitCode}, {outcome.ElapsedMs:0} ms, reported line: {outcome.LastLine}\"\n                : $\"{label} did not run: {outcome.StartError}\");\n            return outcome.Verdict;\n        }\n        catch (Exception ex)\n        {\n            // Reachable only AFTER the process started (RunnerProcess.Run returns a failed start as an outcome,\n            // not as an exception): something ran and its output could not be read. That is not \"did not run\".\n            StatusText = $\"{label} ended abnormally: {ex.Message}\";\n            Log($\"{label} ended abnormally: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>True while the self-check child process is running.</summary>\n    public bool SelfCheckRunning\n    {\n        get => _selfCheckRunning;\n        private set => SetProperty(ref _selfCheckRunning, value);\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Verdict of the last self-check run; null before one has finished.</summary>\n    public bool?         {\n                // #178: an empty id would zip evidence/ into a file inside it.\n                StatusText = \"Export failed: no run set has started.\";\n                Log(StatusText);\n                return;\n            }\n\n            var evidenceDir = Path.Combine(GuiDataPaths.Root, \"evidence\", RunSet.RunId);\n            if (!Directory.Exists(evidenceDir))\n            {\n                StatusText = \"No evidence directory found for current run-set.\";\n                Log(StatusText);\n                return;\n            }\n\n            var bundleDir = Path.Combine(GuiDataPaths.Root, \"evidence\", \"bundles\");\n            Directory.CreateDirectory(bundleDir);\n\n            var zipPath = Path.Combine(bundleDir, $\"{RunSet.RunId}.zip\");\n            if (File.Exists(zipPath))\n                File.Delete(zipPath);\n\n            System.IO.Compression.ZipFile.CreateFromDirectory(evidenceDir, zipPath);\n            StatusText = $\"Evidence bundle exported: {zipPath}\";\n            Log(StatusText);\n        }\n        catch (Exception ex)\n        {\n            StatusText = $\"Export failed: {ex.Message}\";\n            Log(StatusText);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Draws both workbench lanes from ONE original (#173, GUI-C-113).\n    ///\n    /// <para>The workbench compares settings, not images, so the frame handed to each lane is the same\n    /// object and only the settings differ: Lane A (Reference) runs the snapshot as it stands, Lane B\n    /// (Candidate) runs a COPY of it with the override applied. The copy matters \u2014 mutating the shared\n    /// snapshot would make the lanes one pipeline wearing two labels, which is the failure L-02 exists\n    /// to catch.</para>\n    ///\n    /// <para>An override of 0 means \"follow the Reference\", and then both lanes run identical settings\n    /// and must draw identical pixels. That is the control case: if they differ there, the lanes are\n    /// not drawing the same original.</para>\n    /// </summary>\n    private async Task RenderLanesAsync(LoadedImageFrame sourceFrame, AppSettings inputs, System.Windows.Media.ImageSource? reference, BackendTicket ticket, long renderId)\n    {\n        // GUI-C-186e: the Candidate's chain (which can include the AI stage, and so the AI session gate) runs in the background like the\n        // main render's does. It used to run here, on the UI thread, after the await above: measured 3028 ms of UI-dispatcher\n        // latency behind a gate held for 3000 ms. Only the result comes back.\n        // GUI-C-186f: the ticket is the Apply's own (backend + lifetime generation). It is asked BEFORE the lanes are touched or any\n        // work is scheduled, after the await, and in the failure path: a lane task of a backend that was shut down or replaced neither\n        // draws, nor starts more work, nor erases the lanes a newer render drew.\n        var backend = (IXpeBackend)ticket.Backend!;\n        if (!IsCurrent(ticket))\n        {\n            Log(\"Lane rendering skipped: the backend was shut down or replaced since this render started.\");\n            return;\n        }\n\n        try\n        {\n            // The Reference IS what the main viewport just drew \u2014 same original, same settings. Running\n            // the pipeline again for it would be a second computation of a result already in hand, and\n            // it would not be the same claim either: two runs of one setting can only agree.\n            UpdateRender(renderId, r => r with { LaneA = reference });\n\n            // With no override the Candidate is the Reference, so nothing is run for it either. That\n            // keeps an ordinary apply at exactly one pipeline call \u2014 measured: adding a second and third\n            // call broke W-23 and W-26, which count the calls an Apply makes through the fault-injection\n            // seam. The cost is paid only when the user actually asks the two lanes to differ.\n            var differs = inputs.LaneBVoiWindowWidth > 0.0f\n                || !string.Equals(inputs.LaneBAlgorithm, inputs.LaneAAlgorithm, StringComparison.Ordinal)\n                || Math.Abs(inputs.LaneBGsvgDenoiseK - inputs.GsvgDenoiseK) > 0.0001;\n\n            if (differs)\n            {\n                var candidate = inputs.Snapshot();\n                AlgorithmPreset.For(inputs.LaneBAlgorithm).ApplyTo(candidate);\n                if (inputs.LaneBVoiWindowWidth > 0.0f)\n                {\n                    candidate.VoiWindowWidth = inputs.LaneBVoiWindowWidth;\n                    candidate.VoiWindowAuto = false;   // GUI-C-233: an explicit Candidate width is a window chosen by hand\n                }\n\n                // The Candidate's own vg_denoise_k.
